description: What a verification SMS costs in every country it can be sent to, in credits, sorted by country name. Each country is priced for a typical mobile number and checked at least once a day (`checked_at`, UTC); carriers within a country can differ, so use Estimate Cost for an exact number. Countries SMS cannot be sent to are left out. Group: Pricing. Billing per call: Requests: metered (~0.41 avg).
